description.value: Hana Sushi is a fully licensed, family-run Japanese-Korean fusion restaurant in Abbotsford's Mt Lehman area, staffed by chefs trained in both culinary traditions. The menu spans traditional sushi, Korean BBQ skewers, and a variety of vegetarian options, all served in a casual atmosphere.
